truths.truth: The app binds to whatever HQPTUNER_LISTEN_HOST carries, on the desktop launch path, and the code default stays 127.0.0.1
truths.evidence: hqptuner/config.py:127 listen_host = _env("LISTEN_HOST", "127.0.0.1"); hqptuner/__main__.py:40 run(host=cfg.listen_host); hqptuner/desktop.py:315 launch calls main(run=partial(serve, parts=parts)); desktop.py:266 serve -> parts.listen(host=host) -> desktop.py:207 uvicorn.Config(host=host). Spot-check: `HQPTUNER_LISTEN_HOST=0.0.0.0` then `Config().listen_host` printed `0.0.0.0`.

truths.truth: The installer hands HQPTUNER_LISTEN_HOST=0.0.0.0 to every launch it starts from [Run], finish-page checkbox and /LAUNCH alike, and keeps the HKCU registry value for later launches from one shared definition
truths.evidence: packaging/windows/hqptuner.iss:15 `#define ListenHost "0.0.0.0"`; :46 [Registry] HKCU\Environment ValueData "{#ListenHost}" with uninsdeletevalue; :55-56 SetEnvironmentVariableW external from kernel32.dll; :82-86 InitializeSetup sets HQPTUNER_LISTEN_HOST to '{#ListenHost}' before any wizard page or [Run] entry, in silent and interactive mode alike; :52 the only [Run] entry (nowait postinstall, Check: LaunchWanted, no unchecked flag) is what both the finish-page checkbox and the /LAUNCH path execute. ChangesEnvironment=yes kept at :30. That Setup's [Run] child inherits the variable is Windows runtime behavior and belongs to UAT item 2 (ci: smoke-windows), left pending.

truths.truth: A silent install starts the app only when its command line carries /LAUNCH, matched case-insensitively; the interactive wizard still offers the launch
truths.evidence: packaging/windows/hqptuner.iss:70-78 LaunchWanted: Result := not WizardSilent, then any ParamStr(I) with CompareText(..., '/LAUNCH') = 0 sets True; no {param:} constant, no skipifsilent. The runtime half (no HQPTuner.exe after /VERYSILENT without the switch) is UAT item 5 (ci: smoke-windows), left pending.
